secrets.name: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY
secrets.description: Emergent LLM API key for Claude Sonnet sentiment analysis (optional — app falls back to a lexical heuristic without it). Obtain from the Emergent dashboard.

secrets.name: EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY
secrets.description: Emergent push notification key for the SuprSend relay (optional — push notifications are skipped without it). Obtain from the Emergent dashboard.
